string.text: Isolating Artefact Module. A light shielded case for a single artefact.\n \n%c[ui_gray_3]Storage only: the artefact inside does not work, does not irradiate you and does not degrade. Lighter than the lead box.
Lead-lined box for a single artefact. Heavy and simple, but it does the job.\n \n%c[ui_gray_3]Storage only: the artefact inside does not work, does not irradiate you and does not degrade.

Artefact Absorbing Container. A belt module that filters the radiation of the artefact inside.\n \n%c[ui_gray_3]On the belt: the artefact works at 75 %% strength, gives no radiation (artefacts that remove radiation keep doing it) and degrades 2x slower.

Artefact Absorbing Module. The best belt module available in the Zone.\n \n%c[ui_gray_3]On the belt: the artefact works at full strength, gives no radiation (artefacts that remove radiation keep doing it) and does not degrade.
